modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lazycraft: A collection of quality-of-life crafting features to make crafting feel intuitive.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.title: LazyCraft
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recipeB: Enables LazyCraft's additional recipe-book click actions.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recursi: Allows ghost recipes to craft their missing crafting-table dependencies.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.showRec: Checks recipes in the background and shows recursively craftable recipes as available. Disable this to keep the recipe book stable.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.backgro: Additional delay after each background recipe check.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.recursi: Maximum number of dependency levels searched for recursive crafting plans.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.maxCand: Maximum candidate plans kept at each search layer. Higher values may find more or better plans, but use more time and memory.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.serverU: How long LazyCraft waits for a server menu update before cancelling.
text.autoconfig.lazycraft.option.stepDel: Extra delay after the server confirms each recipe step. Zero continues immediately; one waits one client tick.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.least_total_: Uses the fewest ingredient items across the full plan.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.fastest_exec: Runs recipes the fewest total times.
Prefers fewer stages, then fewer ingredients.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.shallowest_c: Uses the fewest nested crafting levels.
Prefers fewer crafts, ingredients, then stages.
text.lazycraft.scoring_mode.least_overpr: Creates the fewest extra items from recipe batch sizes.
Prefers fewer ingredients, crafts, then stages.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.empty_hand: Hold an item in either hand, or provide an item ID.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.unavailable: A shopping list cannot be calculated right now.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.failed: The shopping list calculation failed. See the log for details.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.inventory_ch: Your inventory changed while calculating. Run the command again for an accurate list.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.no_recipe: No supported crafting-table recipe was found for %s.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.complete: You already have everything needed to craft %s.
commands.lazycraft.shopping.title: Missing %s for %s:
